summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter and nine-month 2026 results press release and financial report. Q3 net income was $16.6 million ($0.68 per share), adjusted net income $12.4 million ($0.51); 9M net income $31.7 million ($1.31). Balance sheet showed $141.7 million cash, $358.2 million liquidity, and no significant maturities until Q4 2031 post-refinancing. Fleet comprised 29 owned and 32 chartered-in vessels. The only transaction noted was the routine Q3 sale of the 2009-built Supramax Bermondi, a $2.5 million gain. No special-situation event; no deal terms.
